queries.rationale: Explicit skill/alias evidence should precede titles with unsupported mandatory skills; explicit country mismatch and closed listings are excluded.
Missing salary/country facts remain unknown; documented two years must not become eight; unavailable descriptions and integrated unknown availability are not scored recommendations.
Support and Excel evidence can support an adjacent operations role without inventing data-analysis proficiency or relevant years.
An aspirational target role alone does not establish professional qualifications or justify a numerical score.
